ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimSynapse - Factions[/h1] [b]📚 [url=https://github.com/RimSynapse/RimSynapse-Factions/wiki]Official Wiki & Documentation[/url][/b]
[b]Companion Mod for RimSynapse.[/b] Intercepts world generation to dynamically spawn cloned factions, establish geographic settlement territories, and generate deep LLM histories for the resulting empires and nations.
[h2]Compatibility Matrix[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Royalty DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Enables royal splinter houses and vassalage generation. [*] [b]Ideology DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Integrates holy wars and organically generated schisms. [*] [b]Biotech DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Enables entire factions composed of xenotype warmongers. [*] [b]Anomaly DLC:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Generates hidden cult factions that worship the void. [*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3760830041]RimSynapse - Psychology[/url]:[/b] Compatible & Optional. Made better with Psychology! Automatically generates deep psychological profiles, traits, and backstories for Faction Leaders. [/list]
